text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: eu-west1 GPU pool reporting 58% node failures and provisioning errors. Autoscaler retries failing with 'instance init timeout'. Possible image/boot regression. Failing capacity for hosted inference.

sam: seeing 502/504 spikes from hosted-api-eu across multiple customers, p50 latency doubled. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/insights?view=euw1

laura: confirming — kube events show lots of 'FailedAttachVolume' followed by reboot loops. Could be a kernel/driver mismatch in the new AMI we rolled last night.

alex: we need immediate mitigation. Suggest two steps: 1) emergency per-customer rate limits for top tail customers in eu-west1, 2) traffic shift best-effort to us-east1 for non-data-resident tenants.

mira: agree. I'll compile top-20 consumers by RPS and compute safe RPS cut to bring cluster load to <70%.

laura: creating temporary quota policy in admin to cap heavy customers to 0.5 rps or a 50% reduction, whichever is lower. Applying gradually to avoid thundering herd. Sample command:
```bash
# lock customer to reduced rate via admin API
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/quotas -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"customer_id":"<CUSTOMER_ID>","rate_limit_rps":0.5,"scope":"tenant","note":"eu-west1 degraded - temp cap"}'
```

sam: for the customers with strict region requirements, we'll keep them on reduced quota but pinned to eu-west1. For others, routing rules to prefer us-east1 fallback. Who can update the SmartRouter policy?

alex: I can push a rollback of the last AMI to start new nodes without the suspect image, but it will take ~20m to spin and join. In the meantime, do throttles + reroute.

mira: pushing the list to #eng-sre and DMing oncall. Here's the initial top-8 I recommend for immediate caps: acme-inc, beta-stream, gamma-ml, delta-search, statix, fastpay, userlytics, bigbatch.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Applying policy changes now — executing bulk cap script. Will rotate in waves of 4 every 60s to avoid simultaneous client reconnect storms.

deploy-bot: Quota change applied for acme-inc (txn=0x7f3a). previous_rps=8.0 new_rps=0.5.

sam: acme-inc reported ~30% 5xx before cap, now 4xx rate-limited. We should notify support to set expectations and post customer-facing advisory.

laura: adding a maintenance note to status page and opening a short incident banner. Also creating runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbook/euwest-gpu-degraded

alex: rollback trigger is green — initiating instance pool replace to previous AMI. Replacement will start immediately; ETA first healthy back in ~18m.

mira: reroute rules updated to prefer us-east1 for non-data-resident sessions. Traffic shift looks like ~12% leaving eu-west1 over 10 min window.

sam: p50 latency trending down for remaining eu-west1 traffic. Overall token throughput still lower than normal but stabilizing.

oncall-sre: monitoring KV cache hit ratios and staying on watch. If autoscaler remains failing after new nodes, we'll flip to emergency cross-region read-through for cached prefixes.

laura: action items: (1) alex continue AMI replace and monitor join metrics, (2) mira continue capping heavy tenants and provide updated list, (3) sam coordinate customer comms with support, (4) oncall-sre monitor cluster health and autoscaler logs.

sam: assigned. Can we set a rollback window for the quota caps in 2 hours so we don't leave them forever?

laura: yes — caps auto-expire in 2h unless extended. I'll annotate each quota with reason and expiry.

deploy-bot: AMI rollback job started (job=ami-rollback-1768004321). First 20 instances provisioning.

mira: after first wave of caps, cluster CPU on eu-west1 dropped ~35%, GPU util down to safe levels. Good indicator.

alex: first rollback instances ready and joined. kube nodes READY count increasing.

sam: beginning to slowly lift caps for 4 tenants that are routed to us-east1. Will keep top 4 capped until full capacity returns.

laura: great. Keep this thread updated with the last checks. I'll prep postmortem skeleton once we stabilize.

deploy-bot: AMI rollback completed for pool-euw1 (version reverted).

oncall-sre: autoscaler retries stopped failing after new nodes joined. Provisioning errors cleared. Observability shows successful attach volume ops.

mira: removing temporary caps for tenants moved to us-east1. Remaining caps scheduled to expire in 40 minutes.

sam: metrics look healthy. p95 latency back to baseline for most customers. No further 5xx cascades.

laura: marking incident as 'mitigated' in tracker. Will keep banner live for 1h. Postmortem owner: laura.

ops-bot: Incident mitigated: eu-west1 GPU pool degraded -> mitigated. Summary: AMI rollback + targeted per-customer caps + cross-region routing. Postmortem: https://go.redwood/pm/euw1-ami-regression

sam: :white_check_mark: Nice work everyone.

mira: :eyes: I'll send the final capped list + timestamps to #support for customer follow-ups.

laura: closing thread in 30m if no regressions. Thanks all.
